steps.name: Capacity
steps.formula: No absences confirmed → capacity from the people list with the announced absences from the PO pre-planning

steps.name: norm. velocity trend
steps.formula: norm. velocity trend = value_prev (flat)

steps.name: Forecast PLAN
steps.formula: Forecast PLAN = rounded down to 1 digit(s): (norm. velocity trend / reference capacity × capacity)

steps.name: Plannable
steps.formula: Plannable = Forecast PLAN × plannable share

steps.name: Small items
steps.formula: Small stuff = Forecast PLAN − plannable
